title: Blood Spiral
summary: The Blood Spiral are a cult of evil Seekers whose purpose is to serve the will of the Betrayer, the sworn ancestral enemy of the Casterwill family, and to erase all life by bringing the Nullifiers back to Earth. The group have a long history of tradition and ritual, using dark, ancient magic and Titans, and with every member bearing a tattoo of the sigil of the Spiral Mark, the original beacon that first summoned the Nullifiers. Commanded by the diabolical Rassimov and his Blooded Circle, the Spirals are considered by many Seekers to be the most dangerous force on Earth.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Blood Spiral Brotherhood was founded by the Betrayer, who betrayed his best friend, Lord Casterwill, and became mortal enemies with his family when he attempted to perform a dark ritual on the Spiral Mark, summoning Void to reactivate the Mark and use it as a beacon to call back the Nullifiers to earth. He was defeated by Lord Casterwill's children however, leaving the Blood Spiral Brotherhood mortal enemies with the Casterwill family and sworn on revenge. [Chasing Void]
Throughout the generations, the Blood Spiral remained hidden, hunting down and eliminating whole branches of the Casterwill family. [Chasing Void] One of their young hunters, the pyromaniac Kiel, succeeded in setting the Paris Casterwill house aflame, killing the parents of Sophie Casterwill and separating her from her big brother, Lucas. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

At some point in time, Rassimov began working for the Organization, in order to cripple them from the inside. He rose through their ranks to become one of the Professor's most senior operatives before setting up his downfall to the Huntik team by giving the Amulet of Archwarder to Dante Vale. [The Divine Comedy] With this Titan, the Huntik Foundation was able to weaken the Legendary Titan of Immortality, Overlos, defeat the Professor and send his Legendary Titans back to the Spirit World, successfully removing the Professor as a threat to the Blood Spiral's goals. [The Mission]

After the fall of the Professor, the Blood Spiral Brotherhood emerged from the shadows of history and revealed themselves to both the Huntik Foundation and the Organization alike at Klaus' bookshop. There they recovered the Amulet of the evil Void in order to resurrect the rest of the Nullifiers and left the destruction in their wake. [The Blood Spiral]

sections.wikitext: The only known base of the Blood Spiral is the [[Blood Spiral Base]], located in a desert region of the Siberian Plateau where there are known to be training rooms, the Betrayer´s throne room and the [[Spiral Mark]]. {{source|Words from Eathon}}

sections.heading: Members
sections.wikitext:
''See also the [[:Category:Blood Spiral members|List of Blood Spiral Members]]''

[[File:S2E49 Shauna Rassimov Wind.png|thumb]]
The Blood Spiral is run by [[Rassimov]], who carries out the orders of the incorporeal [[the Betrayer|Betrayer]]. Rassimov is a terribly powerful seeker and later died when he tried to obtain the power of the [[Red Comet]]. At almost Rassimov's level are [[Shauna]] and the silent [[Wind]]. Under them is also [[Tantras]], who recruits new minions to serve the will of the Spiral and who also trains these recruits along with training most of their powerful seekers like [[Harrison]] and [[Kiel]] to destroy the Casterwills.

The [[Casterwill Hunters]] are higher versions of the [[Silent Soldiers]], being a more powerful and a greater threat to the [[Huntik Foundation]]. They serve Kiel and [[Marduk]], and will do anything to capture and destroy one more member of the Blood Spiral's hated enemies, the [[Casterwill family]].

Upon entry into the Blood Spiral, a Spiral mark is placed on the member. These marks connect the group and can grant power to the Spiral member. They can also be used to signal the members or inflict pain to the member. {{Source|Dante's Return}}

The basic class of Blood Spiral members are the [[Silent Soldiers]]. Much like [[the Organization]]'s [[Suits]], the Silent Soldiers do the bidding of the Spiral and are the bulk of their members. [[Harrison Fears]] was inducted into the order along with his brother, [[Den Fears]], although the latter defected to the [[Huntik Foundation]]. [[Zhalia Moon]], who had grown up in the same orphanage as the Fears brothers, joined the Silent Soldier ranks as a double agent in order to protect Harrison. Many of the members are scouted from vulnerable and damaged backgrounds such as orphanages, with the Spiral taking advantage of the darkness and pain of individuals to tempt them with ideas of power and self-worth.

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
The Blood Spiral Brotherhood mainly relies on dark and ancient magic. Spells that are shown in the series include [[Darkvoid]], [[Darkwave]], [[Bladewave]], [[Cutrace]] and [[Hopeshatter]]. They also use dark incantations including [[Underfear]] and [[Newfury]] to increase the negative emotions in a targeted Seeker, namely new recruits

Like their spells, their Titans also revolve around dark powers, including ancient [[Hecto-Titans]]. The Blood Spiral's foot soldiers, the [[Silent Soldiers]], primarily use Titans that draw power from dark emotions like rage and fear including [[Harlekin]] and [[Marauder]].
